newsitem.title: UK: Heron in 135 mln stg France, Spain programme.
newsitem.headline: Heron in 135 mln stg France, Spain programme.

text.p: Unlisted British property company Heron International said on Tuesday it would develop five sites in Spain and France worth a total 135 million stg.
Heron said it would develop a leisure and retail complex in Madrid, two sites in Paris and two in the north of France.
It said the Madrid site included a leisure park with multiplex cinema and a factory outlet. The site will create around 1,000 jobs, Heron said.

The French developments will include multiplex cinemas and restaurants. Heron said it was in advanced discussions with leading international leisure groups and cinema operators regarding prospective tenancies.
